verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents prompt/prefix caching explicitly, including cache_control breakpoints, 5-minute/1-hour TTLs, and the cost/latency benefit for repetitive tasks, and pricing docs publish per-MTok cache write/hit prices alongside base input/output prices for every model. This directly satisfies the ml-engineer's need to cut cost and latency on repeated context with documented pricing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmark confirming real-world cache hit-rate savings and no community corroboration specifically on caching cost reductions (community evidence cited is about general pricing/rate limits, not caching).
